findings.explanation: Co che dedup ben vung (storage.tryMarkMid, khoa = tenant/pageId+mid, KHONG co TTL - permanent unique record trong Postgres, xem core/storage/postgres-adapter.js:1114-1134) chi duoc kich hoat khi `mid` ton tai (webhook.js:657 `if (mid) {`). `mid` chi lay tu `event.message?.mid`, tuc CHI co o su kien tin nhan (text/quick_reply). Su kien postback (nut bam, persistent menu, referral-only auto-menu xu ly tai webhook.js:754-760 -> menuCodeHandoffHandler.handleReferralOnly) khong bao gio co `message.mid` nen HOAN TOAN bo qua buoc idempotency ben vung nay - ca o duong xu ly truc tiep lan duong qua webhookQueue (core/webhook-queue.js enqueueEvent chi INSERT, khong co unique constraint/dedup theo mid). Cac duong nay chi con duoc bao ve boi bo nho tam trong-process: recentMessageTextKeys TTL 5s (webhook.js:26, MESSAGE_TEXT_DEDUPE_TTL_MS, chi khop khi normalizedText giong het) hoac recentMenuSendKeys cooldown 15s (webhook.js:28, MENU_SEND_COOLDOWN_MS) cho luong sendMenu. Ca hai deu la Map trong bo nho: mat sach khi process restart/deploy, khong dung chung giua nhieu instance khi scale ngang, va TTL 5-15s ngan hon nhieu so voi khoang retry thuc te cua Facebook khi khong nhan HTTP 200 kip thoi. Ket qua: postback bi Facebook gui lai sau hon 5-15s (hoac sau khi service restart giua 2 lan retry) se duoc xu ly lai tu dau va GUI TRUNG tin nhan/menu/anh cho khach - dung kich ban su co production da xay ra.
